title: Macron calls for 'calm and order' after riots across France
description: French President Emmanuel Macron gives a national address after widespread disorder and as some looting continued in Paris.

title: What we know so far about deadly fire at Canadian military base
description: At least four people are confirmed to have died after a huge fire swept through the base.

title: Polanski says he will not overturn Green Party's 'Zionism is racism' motion
description: The Green Party leader said, while he wanted to amend it, the motion would stand until 2028.

title: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
description: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as the country battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

title: Inside Chicago's battle against the synthetic drugs flooding the US
description: A new wave of synthetic drugs is sweeping across the United States, raising fear of a worsening drug crisis. The BBC's Quentin Sommerville reports from the frontlines in South Side, Chicago, where communities are battling the crisis.

title: Cindy Crawford 'beyond heartbroken' after death of son Presley at 27
description: Presley Gerber's death in September is being investigated as a suspected overdose.

title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
description: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

title: Ending corridor care in hospitals for children a priority, says health secretary
description: Yvette Cooper also announces £140m investment in England's urgent care system, ahead of winter.

title: Suspects hunted after police officer injured in shooting
description: A firearm has been recovered by officers after a man and a woman fled the scene, detectives say.
